scope: Gold-informed explanatory analysis of the pre-existing 470x96 per-axis discrimination matrix; no representation rebuild.
interpretation: The amount, count and concentration/effective-dimension of marginal gold-vs-nongold axis discrimination show only weak association with per-question SIGN-minus-float advantage. Simple marginal-signal concentration is therefore not a useful LME mechanism explanation. This strengthens the need to test joint sign-bit redundancy and retrieval-competition interactions.
epistemic_note: Post-hoc and gold-informed; explanatory only, not deployable and not causal.
